---
name: ponytail
description: Keep BharatQuant changes minimal and complete without sacrificing safety, accessibility, or verification.
---

# Ponytail

For each coding task, inspect the existing implementation and all relevant callers before choosing a change. Reuse project helpers, platform features, and installed dependencies. Avoid unrequested options, dependencies, abstractions, and future-proofing; delete complexity when deletion fully solves the problem.

Minimal does not mean incomplete: preserve validation, error handling, security, data-integrity protections, accessibility, required call sites, and tests. Add a focused check for non-trivial behavior and report what was not verified or any remaining risk.

This project guidance is an original summary inspired by [DietrichGebert/ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail). It does not install Ponytail's plugin or make its slash commands available.
